Memberships

Silver Circle

Your gateway to insider access and exclusive opportunities.

The Silver Circle Membership is a complimentary insider program designed for travelers who want to stay connected with Zohery Tours and enjoy early access to special offers.

Silver Circle Benefits:
    •    ✅ Free Membership – No cost to join
    •    ✅ Early Tour Access – Be the first to hear about upcoming tours
    •    ✅ Exclusive Member-Only Offers – Special promotions not available to the public
    •    ✅ Priority Invitations – Access to select cultural events and limited tours
    •    ✅ Insider Updates – News, announcements, and travel insights

Upgrade anytime to Gold Circle and unlock premium savings and free tickets.


    Gold Circle

    Maximum value. Exclusive access. Unmatched savings.

    The Gold Circle Membership is our premium annual program for travelers who want the best value, flexibility, and VIP treatment when exploring Washington, D.C.

    Gold Circle Benefits:
        •    ⭐ Two Complimentary Tickets upon joining
        •    ⭐ 25% OFF All Additional Tickets – Unlimited use for one full year
        •    ⭐ Share Your Savings with family, friends, or guests
        •    ⭐ Priority Booking on popular and limited-capacity tours
        •    ⭐ VIP Member Recognition

    Discounts Apply To:
        •    ✔ Grand Tour of Washington, D.C.
        •    ✔ Mini Grand Tour
        •    ✔ Explore Egypt in Washington, D.C.
